action.description_en: The processing intent for the user question. search indicates that a search is performed, answer indicates that a direct answer is provided, and clarify indicates that further clarification is required
action.description_zh: 用户问题的处理意图。search 表示执行搜索，answer 表示直接回答，clarify 表示需要进一步澄清

cards.description_en: The list of rich media cards. This is an empty array if no cards are matched or if card return is disabled
cards.description_zh: 富媒体卡片列表；未命中卡片或关闭卡片返回时为空数组

cardData.description_en: The actual business data of the card

content.description_en: The final answer or clarification content. This may contain [[cite:n]] when citation markers are enabled
content.description_zh: 最终回答或澄清问题内容；启用引用角标时可能包含 [[cite:n]]

id.description_en: The request ID, which is the same as requestId

type.description_en: The event type, which is the same as event

event.description_en:
The event type. When stream is set to true, this is the type field of a single Server-Sent Events (SSE) frame, which is consistent with data.type.

Lifecycle
start / finish
Marks the beginning and end of a message. start carries the messageId.

Text content
text-start / text-delta / text-end
Streaming output of the Markdown body. The same text block shares an id.

Recalled intermediate results (only when action=search)
data-recall
Deduplicated recalled items for the frontend to display the thinking procedure.

Source references (only when action=search)
data-reference
List of web sources, where items[].sourceType=web.

Follow-up recommendations (when enableFollowUp=true and results exist)
data-follow-up
The questions array.

Stage latency (all branches)
data-usage
qp_ms / recall_rank_ms / first_token_ms / answer_ms / follow_up_ms / grand_total_ms / input_tokens / output_tokens / total_tokens (selected based on the branch).

Exceptions
error (errorText / errorCode / retryable) → finish (finishReason=error) → [DONE]

Typical sequences:
search: start → data-recall → text-* → data-reference → [data-follow-up] → data-usage → finish → [DONE]
answer: start → text-* → [data-follow-up] → data-usage → finish → [DONE]
clarify: start → text-* → data-usage → finish → [DONE]

Note: Does not include text-image-video template events such as data-qp, data-ranked, data-image-info, data-video-info, or json-*
event.description_zh:
事件类型（stream=true 时 SSE 单帧 type 字段；与 data.type 一致）：

生命周期
start / finish
标记消息开始与结束；start 携带 messageId

文本内容
text-start / text-delta / text-end
Markdown 正文流式输出；同一文本块共享 id

召回中间结果（仅 action=search）
data-recall
去重后召回 items，供前端「思考过程」展示

信源引用（仅 action=search）
data-reference
web 信源列表，items[].sourceType=web

追问推荐（enableFollowUp=true 且有结果）
data-follow-up
questions 数组

阶段耗时（所有分支）
data-usage
qp_ms / recall_rank_ms / first_token_ms / answer_ms / follow_up_ms / grand_total_ms / input_tokens / output_tokens / total_tokens（按分支取舍）

异常
error（errorText / errorCode / retryable）→ finish(finishReason=error) → [DONE]

典型序列：
search: start → data-recall → text-* → data-reference → [data-follow-up] → data-usage → finish → [DONE]
answer: start → text-* → [data-follow-up] → data-usage → finish → [DONE]
clarify: start → text-* → data-usage → finish → [DONE]

注：不含 data-qp / data-ranked / data-image-info / data-video-info / json-* 等图文视频模板事件

finishReason.description_en: The finish reason. The value is stop for success and error for failure
finishReason.description_zh: 完成原因。成功时为 stop，失败时为 error

followUp.description_en: The list of recommended follow-up questions. This is an empty array if follow-up questions are disabled or not generated
followUp.description_zh: 推荐追问问题列表；未启用或未生成追问问题时为空数组

messageId.description_en: The message ID, in the format of msg-{requestId}

reasoningContent.description_en: The complete thinking process of the response model. This is an empty string if thinking mode is disabled or no thinking process is generated
reasoningContent.description_zh: 回复模型的完整思考过程；未开启思考模式或未产生思考过程时为空字符串
reasoningContent.example: 先确认问题涉及的时间范围。

recall.description_en: The intermediate recall results of the web search
recall.description_zh: 联网搜索的中间召回结果

references.description_en: The web content referenced in the final answer. The list is empty if there are no references
references.description_zh: 最终回答引用的网页内容；无引用时列表为空

searchResults.description_en: The final results of web search and successful calls to vertical tools. This is an empty array if there are no results
searchResults.description_zh: 搜索网页结果和成功调用垂类工具的最终结果；无结果时为空数组

coverImage.description_en: The cover image information, which includes the image URL and may include the width and height
coverImage.description_zh: 封面图信息，包含图片地址，并可能包含宽度和高度

id.description_en: The unique ID of the content

logoUrl.description_en: The URL of the site icon. This is an empty string if there is no icon
logoUrl.description_zh: 站点图标地址；没有图标时为空字符串

publishTime.description_en: The publish time in UNIX timestamp seconds. The value is 0 if it cannot be parsed or is not returned by the tool
publishTime.description_zh: 发布时间，使用 Unix 秒级时间戳；无法解析或工具未返回时为 0

result.description_en: The complete structured output result of the tool. This is returned only when the content source type is tool
result.description_zh: 工具的完整结构化输出结果，仅当内容来源类型为 tool 时返回

siteName.description_en: The name of the site or tool provider. This is an empty string if there is no name
siteName.description_zh: 站点或工具提供方名称；没有名称时为空字符串

snippet.description_en: The content summary. For tool results, this is the serialized complete result text. This is an empty string if there is no content
snippet.description_zh: 内容摘要；工具结果为序列化后的完整结果文本，没有内容时为空字符串

sourceType.description_en: The content source type. Valid values: web and tool
sourceType.description_zh: 内容来源类型，取值为 web 或 tool

title.description_en: The web page title or tool name. This is an empty string if there is no title
title.description_zh: 网页标题或工具名称；没有标题时为空字符串

toolName.description_en: The tool name. This is returned only when the content source type is tool
toolName.description_zh: 工具名称，仅当内容来源类型为 tool 时返回

url.description_en: The URL of the result landing page. This is an empty string if there is no URL
url.description_zh: 结果落地页地址；没有地址时为空字符串

usage.description_en: The stage latency, tool metrics, and token usage. The sub-fields vary based on the execution branch
usage.description_zh: 阶段耗时、工具指标和 Token 用量；子字段随执行分支变化
